column3: NKJV has “His twelve disciples,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “the Twelve.”
NKJV has the plural “staffs,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has the singular.
NKJV has “the very dust,” following the Textus Receptus wording.
NKJV includes “by Him,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “all that was happening.”
NKJV has “into a deserted place belonging to the city called Bethsaida,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “to a city called Bethsaida.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV has “here,” where the Greek reads “there” (“on the spot”).
